answers.core: It's part of an efficient workflow that everyone working with scene inheritance would benefit from.
answers.workaround: I think technically it may be possible to re-pack from the scene and override an existing PackedScene asset to mimic that, but there currently are bugs that prevent persisting direct scene inheritance; and there's no API for modifying or persisting SceneState (https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_scenestate.html), which would probably have less sideffects for most of the required operations than plainly repacking the whole scene.

title: Add an editor action to apply changes from inheriting scenes to the base scene
